RBI to enable interoperability among Account Aggregators

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has announced plans to make Account Aggregators (AAs) interoperable, allowing customers to share their financial data through any AA. This move will also integrate bank deposits with the Customer Acquisition System (CAS) for demat accounts. The RBI's decision aims to streamline financial data sharing and enhance customer convenience.
